---
title: "Concepts and architecture"
---

## MethodMesh as a capability layer

MethodMesh sits between a research workflow and specialist Android execution.

```text
EDC workflow
    → canonical MethodMesh capability
    → module or provider adapter
    → Android service, hardware, local model or application
    → structured MethodMesh result
    → EDC workflow
```

## Methods and providers

A **method** describes what should happen. A **provider** describes which implementation performs it.

For example:

```text
navigate.to
    ├── provider: osmand
    └── provider: another compatible navigation app
```

An XLSForm should normally depend on the canonical method, not a package name or exported activity.

## Results

MethodMesh results are expected to distinguish:

- status;
- returned data;
- provenance;
- metadata;
- diagnostics.

A result should make cancellation, permission denial, missing providers, invalid inputs and technical failures distinguishable from success.

## Local data handling

MethodMesh may temporarily hold:

- an image selected for analysis;
- a sensor reading while it is normalized;
- a file passed to a provider;
- a cryptographic payload;
- an execution record.

Participant-level results should return to the EDC rather than becoming a second longitudinal record in MethodMesh.

## RIL

The Research Intent Language provides a platform-independent expression of execution intent. Android intent calls are one transport and execution boundary, not the language itself.

See the [RIL reference](reference/ril.qmd).
